message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h3 && git show fce1c538 -- src/h3lib/lib/coordijk.c src/apps/testapps/testCellToLocalIj.c

message.content:
This is the fix! The vulnerability is in the `res == 0` branch of `localIjkToCell`. The original code checks `ijk->i > 1 || ijk->j > 1 || ijk->k > 1` but this doesn't catch all invalid cases. For example, `ijk = (1, 1, -1)` passes this check (none > 1), but `_unitIjkToDigit` normalizes it to `(2, 2, 0)` which doesn't match any unit vector, returning `INVALID_DIGIT` (7). Then `_getBaseCellNeighbor(originBaseCell, 7)` reads `baseCellNeighbors[originBaseCell][7]` → global buffer overflow READ 4.
